# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Qwen3.8 27B via NInfer; v0.7.3 scope is one NVIDIA RTX 5090 or RTX 4090, with
> restart-resumable OpenAI Responses continuation state. Community project; not affiliated
> with Oh My Pi, Qwen, or NVIDIA.

v0.7.3 is the current public release. It repins only the client to OMP 18.2.3; runtime
bytes, model, serving arguments and floors remain v0.7.2, and performance is carried evidence.
RTX 3090 is deferred, not qualified with the new client. All three published client platforms
passed live inference and provider-free hosted qualification; Linux live proof used Ubuntu
under WSL2, not a separately qualified non-WSL Linux OS. Fresh documented-route proof covers
24 steps across RTX 5090 host/macOS/Windows and RTX 4090 native routes.

## Canonical documents

- [Checkpoint transport and NAS replication](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md#checkpoint-transport-and-nas-replication): implemented export/import and verified off-machine replicas; restore requires matching runtime, model, profile, and credentials; not cross-GPU migration or live NAS serving

- [Canonical facts](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md): entity, fit, guarantees, measured proof, limitations
- [Decision guide](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/DECISION_GUIDE.md): when to choose this vs Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, vLLM
- [v0.7.3 guide](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.7.3/docs/QUICKSTART.md): RTX 5090 on Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2, RTX 4090 native Windows 11; do not bypass the ready gate
- [v0.7.3 manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.7.3/releases/v0.7.3/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile; no support implied for other deployments
- [Release state](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/RELEASES.md): support boundary and acceptance receipts
- [Historical v0.7.2 route](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.7.2/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable three-GPU / OMP 18.0.9 route, including RTX 3090; not new-client qualification
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): qualified client/runtime combinations
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): method and receipt-bound numbers
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): boundaries and support rules
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): named failure signatures
